import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

SPEEDS = np.array([0.8, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.24, 1.28, 1.32, 1.36, 1.4], dtype=float)
MEANS = np.array([5.466666666666667, 6.5675, 6.883333333333334, 7.666666666666667, 8.28, 11.1125, 14.275, 16.171875, 20.4], dtype=float)

def _mu(speed):
    speed = float(speed)
    if speed <= SPEEDS[0]:
        # linear extrapolation from first segment
        x0, x1 = SPEEDS[0], SPEEDS[1]
        y0, y1 = MEANS[0], MEANS[1]
        mu = y0 + (y1 - y0) * (speed - x0) / (x1 - x0)
    elif speed >= SPEEDS[-1]:
        # linear extrapolation from last segment
        x0, x1 = SPEEDS[-2], SPEEDS[-1]
        y0, y1 = MEANS[-2], MEANS[-1]
        mu = y0 + (y1 - y0) * (speed - x0) / (x1 - x0)
    else:
        mu = float(np.interp(speed, SPEEDS, MEANS))
    return max(mu, 1e-9)

def model(regime, n, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    speed = regime.config.get("speed", 1.0)
    mu = _mu(speed)
    y = rng.poisson(mu, size=n)
    return pd.DataFrame({"unit_id": np.arange(n), "y": y.astype(int)})
